records.name: City Athletics Community Partners
records.summary: A nonprofit in North and Northwest Philadelphia that gets kids and families into sports and fitness, with youth soccer, uniform giveaways, and a Juneteenth event.
records.what_you_do: Kids can sign up for the spring soccer program, and families can register for uniform giveaways. The site does not list volunteer roles.

schedule.text: Spring soccer development program for boys and girls ages 4 to 12, listed as CA Spring Soccer 2025. No current dates are posted.

cost.text: The homepage says programs typically cost little or nothing.

first_step.how: Open the Activities page on the website and use the Register Now link for the next soccer program.
first_step.basis: Programs are open to the public with online sign-up, but the page names no tryout and gives no current dates.

records.notes: Newest dated item is CA Spring Soccer 2025 with no month shown, so no last_sign_of_life is written and status is probably_active. The homepage also describes City Athletics as a family-run facility available for rent, and the page does not say how that relates to the nonprofit. The uniform request registration closed July 30 (year not shown). Legal name on the IRS list matches.

records.name: Dope Girls Inc
records.notes: Could not check. Both www.dopegirlsinc.com and dopegirlsinc.com return HTTP 404 on the homepage (not a block, the page is not found). Needs a human check of the IRS record or a current web address before this can be written up. Held without summary, categories, or sources.

records.name: Dynamic Alliance USA
records.notes: The IRS address is in Philadelphia (136 E Meehan Ave) and the site lists a Philadelphia, PA location, but the events the site describes take place in Cameroon, New Jersey, or Bowie, Maryland. Newest dated item is an Adopt an IDP Phase 3 open house held April 11, 2026. Verdict is out_of_area because no Philadelphia program was found. Owner may want to revisit if a Philadelphia program turns up.

records.name: Edg Sports League Corporation
records.notes: Could not check. The IRS record's website field holds a name, not a web address, so it was treated as missing and no site was fetched. One WebSearch for the name with Philadelphia found no matching organization. Results were EDGE Sports Global (Massachusetts) and Philadelphia Sports Leagues, a different group. The IRS address is an apartment address (33 E Roumfort Rd Apt L2), so it may be a residence, not a program site. Needs a human check before this can be written up. Held without summary, categories, or sources.

records.name: Elder Serve Solutions
records.notes: A fee-based fiduciary business: bookkeeping, agent under financial power of attorney, estate administration, and real estate sales on commission. It is a nonprofit on the IRS list, but the site lists no volunteer, membership, or community program. Hidden as a business with no community program. The site shows no dated items, so status is probably_active. Legal name: Elder Serve Solutions Inc.

records.name: Enterprise Project
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit fan project working toward a full-size replica of the starship Enterprise. The ship is not built yet, but anyone can join for free and volunteer-led local chapters are listed.
records.what_you_do: Sign up free on the website, then volunteer with a local chapter, help spread the word, or make videos and images for the project.

schedule.text: No dated events are posted. Local fan chapters are led by volunteers, and the site lists no meeting times.

cost.text: Sign-up is free. The site lists active and partner tiers without prices.

first_step.how: Use the Join Here form on the website to sign up for free, then ask about a local fan chapter.
first_step.basis: Free sign-up is open to anyone and the site invites members to volunteer, but no local meeting times are posted.

records.notes: Newest dated item is the October 2, 2020 Facebook launch, so status is dormant. Copyright years (2022) are not counted. The TEP Talk episodes (85 to 89) and the Real Talk essay are undated. The member count (over 7,000) is the group's own undated figure. The site says the project is independent and not affiliated with the Star Trek franchise owners. Interest tags are the closest fit; there is no tag for fan-built projects. Owner may want to decide whether a fan project belongs in the directory.

records.name: Equal Access Legal Services
records.notes: A nonprofit law practice that charges hourly rates (the site lists $50 to $170 an hour on a sliding scale by income). Immigration and removal defense are the two practice areas. No volunteer, membership, or community program was found, so it is hidden as a business with no community program. Copyright 2025 is not counted as evidence.

records.name: Fair Amount Food Forest
records.summary: A community food forest in Fairmount Park where neighbors plant, tend, and harvest together, with plant walks, cooking and preserving workshops, and a farmers market.
records.what_you_do: Join a planting or tending session, or come to a free workshop on herbs, preserving, pruning, or fruit trees. Vendors can apply to sell at the farmers market.

schedule.text: Weekly and monthly planting and tending sessions, plus Saturday workshops and plant walks listed by date on the events page. A third Saturday plant walk and herbal circle runs most months.

cost.text: Most workshops are free with an Eventbrite RSVP. A few events need registration through a park site, and the wine making classes are for ages 21 and over.

first_step.how: RSVP free on Eventbrite for the Oxymels workshop on Saturday, October 10, 12 to 2 pm, or sign up on the volunteer calendar for the next planting session.
first_step.basis: Events are posted publicly with a free way to RSVP, and the page says walk-ins are welcome at workshops.

records.notes: The 2026 workshop list on the events page has full dates through November 2026. The 2025 items on that page are images with no dates. The July 18 plant walk was canceled for weather. The IRS mailing address is PO Box 18986, but the events page places the food forest at 2300 N 33rd St. No zip is shown on the site, so none is written. Social pages (Facebook, Instagram, Google Group) were not recorded as links because their addresses were not read.

records.name: Familiar Hearts Animal Society
records.summary: A small rescue in Mt. Airy that cares for animals until they find homes, using foster families, adoption, and a pet pantry program.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer through the volunteer page, foster animals in your home through the foster application, or donate items from the wish lists.

schedule.text: Volunteer and foster sign-ups are on the website. The events calendar did not load during research, so no event dates are listed.

first_step.how: Apply through the foster application, or sign up on the volunteer page on the website.
first_step.basis: Volunteer and foster sign-ups are published on the website, though the page does not describe the process step by step.

records.notes: A working site with no dated events or news, so status is probably_active. The events calendar widget did not load, so it may hold dated events that were not seen. The live animal counter shows 0. The events page mentions a Community Hub in Roxborough. The address comes from the IRS record and is not confirmed on the site. The copyright range 2021 to 2025 is not counted as evidence.

records.name: Gathering Place
records.summary: A Philadelphia community space that brings people with different views together for conversation, open mics, paint nights, and small dinners.
records.what_you_do: Apply for a Set The Table dinner (about ten guests are picked to mix viewpoints, and chosen guests pay a $10 reservation fee). Join the event mailing list for open mics and paint nights.

schedule.text: Set The Table dinner dates are to be announced. Open mics and paint nights have no set dates; the event mailing list sends a notice before each one.

cost.text: Chosen Set The Table guests pay a $10 reservation fee. Other event costs are not listed.

first_step.how: Join the event mailing list on the website, and apply for the next Set The Table dinner.
first_step.basis: Dinners need an application and are chosen by the group, so the way in is unclear beyond applying. The mailing list is open to anyone.

records.notes: The site works but shows no dated events. Dinner dates are listed as TBA, so status is probably_active and no last_sign_of_life is written. The homepage gives 2018 as the founding year, which is not a sign of current activity. Only the Set The Table page was read in detail; the Contact, Partner, TRIBE, MEN, and DOZ pages were not read, so no location, contact details, or joining steps for those were recorded. Legal name: Gathering Place Inc.

records.name: Germantown Country Dancers
records.summary: A dance group that holds weekly English country dances, monthly workshops and dances, barn dances, and teen dances, with live bands, callers, and a Colonial performance group.
records.what_you_do: Come to a Wednesday dance or a barn dance with no partner needed. Musicians and sound volunteers are also welcome.

schedule.text: Wednesday English country dances (orientation at 7:30 pm). First Saturday workshop and evening dance, October to May, at Summit Church. First Sunday barn dances, November to April, for all ages. Teen dances for ages 12 to 19 on second Saturdays, October to May, at Summit Church.

locations.label: Merion Friends Meeting Activities Building (Wednesday dances)

cost.text: Sliding scale admission, about $5 to $25 depending on the event. Passes are available for anyone who cannot pay the listed price.

first_step.how: Come to a Wednesday dance. Orientation starts at 7:30 pm. No partner is needed, and flat-soled shoes are recommended.
first_step.basis: An orientation runs before the Wednesday dances, admission is drop-in, and passes are offered to anyone who cannot afford the price.

records.notes: Dated items run from an August 19, 2026 board letter to an October 2026 calendar, so status is active. The Wednesday dances are at Merion Friends Meeting. Merion is in Montgomery County, outside Philadelphia, so the Mt. Airy and teen dances are the in-city events. The site warns that scammers impersonate board members to ask for money, and advises verifying any payment request in person. Membership form is on the site. The Country Dance and Song Society affiliation is named on the site but was not checked.

records.name: GREAT (Germantown Residents for Economic Alternatives Together)
records.summary: A Germantown neighborhood group that shares seeds and tools, runs a mutual aid fund and time bank, and works on housing and emergency preparedness so current residents can stay.
records.what_you_do: Get on the email list, attend learning circles and events, and take part in projects such as the seed library, canning club, and housing outreach.

schedule.text: Events and projects are posted on the website and on social media. An upcoming Germantown Visioning and Collective Action Assembly has no date shown.

first_step.how: Join the email list from the website, then register for the Germantown Visioning and Collective Action Assembly through the register link on the events page.
first_step.basis: The email list and event registration are public, and the site shows no membership step. The assembly date is not shown.

records.notes: Newest dated items are a map labeled 2025 and a 2025 footer, but neither shows a month, so no last_sign_of_life is written and status is probably_active. The 2019 teach-in and the 2020 swap flyer are older. An HJFS 26 flyer is unexplained and was not used. The August 9 hiring deadline shows no year. Mailing address is PO Box 48011, Philadelphia, PA 19144; no meeting place is listed.

records.name: Good As Gold Foundation
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that teaches families money skills and homebuying readiness, with workshops, a nine-month homebuying program, and small grants for people facing hardship.
records.what_you_do: Attend a financial workshop, register for the Golden Keys homebuying cohort, or join the email list. Volunteers, partners, and speakers can apply through the Get Involved page.

schedule.text: The Golden Keys homebuying program is a nine-month cohort for 2026 to 2027, held virtually and in person. Workshop dates are on the website.

first_step.how: Register for the Golden Keys 2026 to 2027 cohort through the online form linked from the website.
first_step.basis: Registration is an online form on the public site, but the page does not say whether the cohort screens people.

records.notes: Called a foundation, but it is a 501(c)(3) that runs its own public workshops and programs, so it is treated as a public program provider, not a private grantmaker. Owner may want to confirm. Workshop prices are not stated. The Youth Development Program is listed with no details. The last sign of life uses the January 2026 photos from the awardee reception (the page does not give the event date). The 2026 scholarships are listed without a month. Legal name: Good As Gold Foundation Inc.

records.name: Halpern Legal Clinic
records.notes: A legal practice that gives free phone advice and low-cost representation in employment and unemployment cases, in New York and Pennsylvania. No volunteer, membership, or community program was found, so it is hidden as a business with no community program. The only date is a 2021 copyright line, which is not counted.

records.name: Hansberry Garden and Nature Center
records.summary: A community garden and environmental education center in Southwest Germantown that grows food and runs classes and public events for children and adults.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer in the garden and report your hours, join as a member (a waiting list form is available), or come to a public event on the calendar.

schedule.text: Public events are on the calendar linked from the News menu. A benefit took place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm. The next event date is not shown.

first_step.how: Check the calendar on the website for the next event, and use the volunteer page to sign up to help in the garden.
first_step.basis: Events are on a public calendar and volunteer sign-up is published, though membership has a waiting list form.

records.notes: The October 3, 2026 benefit date has already passed as of today, so the next event date is not known. Legal name: Hansberry Garden & Nature Center Inc. Mailing address is PO Box 44137, Philadelphia, PA 19144. The site shows no zip for the garden, so none is written. A produce stand collaboration was reported by a local news site; that article was not recorded as a source.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used (cap reached). Fetches: 30 of 60 used. No rate limiting or bot checks seen. Records held without a summary or sources: Dope Girls Inc (website 404 on both addresses, one search found nothing matching) and Edg Sports League Corporation (no web address in the IRS record, one search found nothing matching). Two IRS groups are hidden as businesses with no community program (Elder Serve Solutions, Equal Access Legal Services) and one legal clinic is hidden for the same reason (Halpern Legal Clinic). Dynamic Alliance USA is out_of_area because its programs run in Cameroon, New Jersey, and Maryland. Familiar Hearts' events calendar did not load. Gathering Place's partner and contact pages were not read. The Enterprise Project's TEP Talk episodes are undated, so it stays dormant. Good As Gold Foundation is called a foundation but runs public programs, so it is published; owner may want to confirm.
